Chapter 875: Chapter 15 'The Might Of The World' (Please Subscribe)_2

Chapter 875: Chapter 15 ‘The Might of the World’ (Please Subscribe)_2

But how could Lin Yuan collect resources to cultivate the Xuanhuang Physique if he couldn’t kill those Eleventh Rank Strong Ones of the alien races?

Boom!

An oppressive and heavy aura enveloped an area of seven hundred billion li in an instant, causing tens of thousands of Eleventh Rank Strong Ones to feel their bodies and souls completely suppressed.

It wasn’t an ordinary suppression, but a total suppression, with only one percent of their original strength remaining.

Under Lin Yuan’s Divine Ability ‘World’, the ordinary Eleventh Rank Strong Ones could be crushed instantly.

Even those Eleventh Rank Perfect strong ones, protected by supreme weapons, could only hold on for a few breaths, and that was all.

“What’s happening?”

“My strength has been suppressed by 99%?”

“It’s the Galaxy Master, the source of suppression comes from the Galaxy Master!”

The thought processes of the Eleventh Rank Strong Ones were incredibly fast, and they immediately realized something was wrong. From the arrival of the Galaxy Master on the battlefield to now, only an instant had passed.

Just a moment ago, they were shocked by the sound of the Galaxy Master’s stomping, and the next moment, they all became trapped fishes within the Divine Ability ‘World’.

“Go, immediately get away from the Galaxy Master.”

“Get away from the Galaxy Master, see if we can escape this suppression.”

Numerous Eleventh Rank Strong Ones, almost at the same time, abandoned their battles and turned to flee farther away.

As an instinct of the strong, they knew that hesitating further could result in life or death danger. In such circumstances, the top-tier ethnic group powers remarkably had the same goal and fled in panic.

“Escape? Can they even escape?”

Lin Yuan stood at the center of the coverage of the Divine Ability ‘World’. As the caster of the Divine Ability, he had complete control over everything within seven hundred billion li.

The changes in the expressions of those Eleventh Rank Strong Ones and the turmoil of their inner qi, as they desperately tried different methods, all fell into Lin Yuan’s eyes.

“Die.”

Lin Yuan activated the Divine Ability ‘World’ and used the world power of the seven hundred billion li area to crush all the Strong Ones from the alien races except those from the Human Civilization Alliance.

The duration of the Divine Ability ‘World’ was only six seconds.

From activation of the ‘World’ Divine Ability to covering an area of seven hundred billion li, only one ten-thousandth of a second had passed.

Woosh.

The majestic world power poured down mercilessly.

In just one second, the first round of crushing was completed. In an area of seven hundred billion li, all Eleventh Rank Strong Ones from the first to the fourth tier without supreme weapons were obliterated.

It is worth noting that among the Eleventh Rank Strong Ones from various top-tier ethnic groups who entered the battlefield, although their number reached tens of thousands, those below the fifth tier made up ninety percent.

And now.

Just the first round of crushing by the Divine Ability ‘World’, and ninety percent of the tens of thousands of Eleventh Rank Strong Ones were annihilated, leaving only a few thousand Eleventh Rank Fifth Tier and above strong ones alive.

These strong ones survived not because their own strength was great; to the current Lin Yuan, the difference between the first and the fifth tier of the Eleventh Rank wasn’t that significant.

The reason they could withstand the first round of crushing by Divine Ability ‘World’ was because of the supreme weapons they carried.

The power of the Twelfth Tier protected them.

Of course, even if they survived by relying on the power of the supreme weapons, most of the Eleventh Rank Fifth Tier strong ones were white-faced.

Under the relentless crushing of the vast world power, even if protected by supreme weapons capable of blocking 99.9999% of the force,

the residual qi that seeped in, having just 0.0001% strength left, still heavily injured these Eleventh Rank Fifth Tier Strong Ones.

…

“I’m protected by the supreme armor, and I still can’t completely block it?” The face of the Eleventh Rank Godlord from the Tianyu Clan showed terror, “What, what kind of technique is this?”

This Eleventh Rank Godlord looked around and discovered that ninety percent of the Eleventh Rank Godlords from the Tianyu Clan had turned to ashes, leaving only those few with supreme weapons.

“Run.”

“We can’t stay here any longer.”

The Eleventh Rank Godlord was immediately panicked, having never felt such despair except when facing the supreme beings, even the strongest Eleventh Rank Tianyu Meng from his own clan could not impact him so greatly.

So many Tianyu Clan Eleventh Rank Godlords, all dead?

This Eleventh Rank Godlord wanted to escape at all costs.

But under the oppression of the external world, his speed was as slow as a turtle’s.

Before they could get far, the crushing force of the magnificent second wave of the world’s power suddenly descended.

According to Lin Yuan’s estimation, the external world that lasted for six seconds could complete five rounds of crushing in five seconds.

As for the last second? It was used to detonate the entire external world, which was also the most powerful burst method. What kind of power would it produce once self-destructed within the internal world spanning seven hundred billion miles?

“Ah!!!”

The second wave of crushing descended, and even with the strongest weapon protecting him, that Eleventh Rank Tianyu Clan member couldn’t hold on. The residual force that penetrated obliterated his physical body and soul.

…

The second second passed.

The external world completed the second round of crushing.

Under the second round of crushing, one-fifth of the Eleventh Rank, Fifth Tier strong ones who possessed the strongest weapon protection perished.

As for the Eleventh Rank, Sixth Tier, that is, the Level Eleven Perfect strong ones, they were barely hanging on with the power of the strongest weapon.

“Don’t underestimate these Eleventh Rank…” Lin Yuan thought to himself, as the external world reached the third second and the third wave of world crushing began.

Boom boom boom.

One by one, the Eleventh Rank, Fifth Tier strong ones quickly perished, while the remaining Eleventh Rank, Sixth Tier strong ones’ souls were trembling. They had originally planned to wait and see, but they didn’t expect the consequences to be so severe.

“Run quickly.”

“What exactly is going on?”

“Is it the Galaxy Master who’s making a move?”

“How can the Galaxy Master have such terrifying power?”

“It must be the strongest one, it must be the strongest one making a move.”

“There’s a strongest one breaking the agreement and attacking us.”

The cries of many Eleventh Rank strong ones along with the fluctuations of time and space, echoed continuously within seven hundred billion miles, filled with intense unwillingness and fear.

In the eyes of all Eleventh Rank strong ones, no one else could unleash such powerful attacks except for the strongest ones.

The third second passed.

There were hardly any Eleventh Rank, Fifth Tier strong ones left, and casualties began to appear among the Eleventh Rank, Sixth Tier strong ones.

The strongest weapons are of different types, some are for attack, and some for defense. Some Eleventh Rank, Sixth Tier strong ones, holding attacking-type strongest weapons, perhaps are not as good in defense as the Fifth Tier Eleventh Ranks holding defensive-type strongest weapons.

The fourth second arrived.

“Am I… am I going to die…”

The Four Divine Kings looked desperate, after four consecutive rounds of world’s power crushing, this legendary life of a perfect Eleventh Rank was on the verge of death.

In fact, if not for the strongest weapon protecting him, with the strength of the Four Divine Kings, he most likely wouldn’t have survived past the first second.

“Galaxy Master?”

Before his physical and soul completely collapsed, the Four Divine Kings actually stopped fleeing, turned around, and looked towards the Galaxy Master standing at the center of the battlefield.

Not long ago, when he learned that the Galaxy Master was human Xueyu, aside from being inconceivable, he also felt a gap between himself and the Galaxy Master, probably not as vast as a two-dimensional world.

But now?

Tens of thousands of Eleventh Rank strong ones, including those holding the strongest weapons, couldn’t even last a few seconds in front of the Galaxy Master.

“I…”

The thoughts of the Four Divine Kings suddenly halted, because the embodiment he had on the battlefield had completely died.

…

Lin Yuan surveyed his surroundings.

The moment the Divine Ability ‘World’ was condensed, the tens of thousands of Eleventh Rank caused a great disturbance, trying to break free from the suppression.

But after the first second passed, ninety percent of the Eleventh Rank had died, and the range covered by the external world quieted down a lot, but still filled with some piercing screams and resentful roars.

But the second second, third second, and fourth second passed.

The range of the external world finally quieted down completely.

Four rounds of magnificent world’s power crushing, even the strong ones of Level Eleven Perfect, all perished, leaving only a few dozen of the strongest Eleventh Rank from various peak clans, barely struggling.
